# GetUDPStreamAddress

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [BlitzBasic](BlitzBasic) · [Network](BlitzBasic-Network)

</div>


```blitzbasic
GetUDPStreamAddress:String udp_stream:Int32
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `udp_stream` | In | Int32 | required | The stream. |

**Returns:** The address of this computer that the stream receives on, as text. It is the first of the addresses of [CountHostAddresses](CountHostAddresses) with an empty name, so one that other computers can reach if there is any.

## Description

_Not documented yet._

## Differences

* Not in the original, which only knows IPv4. See [IPv6](IPv6).
